scope: Local browser observation after adding Spanish operation summaries, descriptions and display groups to the static API reference. This is not a production performance claim.

environment.application: Rust debug server behind the local HTTPS test proxy; SvelteKit production build
environment.database: Disposable Percona Distribution for PostgreSQL container
environment.cacheSequence: One fresh es-CR browser context for the cold navigation, followed by a reload in the same context for the warm navigation. No request interception was enabled for this sample.

routeBundle.includes: The API-reference route entry, its eagerly imported JavaScript dependencies and route CSS, counted once from the SvelteKit build manifest.
routeBundle.excludes: Shared application chunks, separately fetched OpenAPI JSON, and content already held in the browser cache.

verification.assetBudget: make test-browser-focused passed; the deterministic API-route gzip budget is 80 KiB and the route measured 74,689 gzip bytes.
verification.apiPayload: The same-build static OpenAPI document transferred 45,807 encoded bytes. The previous 2026-09-26 observation recorded 38,938 bytes; the source revisions differ, so the increase is not attributed solely to the Spanish operation text.
verification.browserSuite: The HTTPS API-reference flow passed localized operation and group text, English and Spanish search terms, stable operation links, safe hostile-text rendering, copy/download, signed-out behavior, cookie omission, mobile width and zoom bounds.
verification.contractChecks: make api-spec-check and 13 source-defined API contract tests passed, including missing, empty and oversized Spanish operation text.

limitations: This sample was captured from a dirty working tree based on the recorded source revision; it is evidence for this implementation pass, not a clean release-build record.
Cold and warm figures are single-run observations on one local host. They are not stable latency percentiles or production capacity promises.
The comparison with the prior artifact uses different source revisions and cannot isolate the cost of the Spanish translations.
The route bundle budget excludes the separately fetched OpenAPI document; both sizes are recorded independently.
Manual screen-reader review and mechanical Rust-handler/schema parity remain open work for issue #43.
